raw.title: Technischer Senior Projektmanager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Dein Plus bei der vitagroup

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Mobile Office
  • Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im europäischen Ausland
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Auslandskrankenversicherung
  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, Sozialleistungen und einen leistungsabhängigen Bonus
  • JobRad: Fahrrad-Leasing zur beruflichen und privaten Nutzung
  • Attraktive MitarbeiterInnen-Rabatte
  • Offene Feedback-Kultur und individuelle Weiterbildung
  • Interdisziplinäre Aufgaben
  • Agile & digitale Unternehmensstrukturen
  • Über 20 Jahre Wissen & Erfahrung in der digitalen Gesundheitswelt
  • Mentoring & Wissensaustausch


Dafür brauchen wir Dich

  • Du übernimmst die technische Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte von der Planung bis zur Fertigstellung und erarbeitest eigenständig erste Vorschläge zur Zielarchitektur und zum Schnittstellendesign
  • Du arbeitest nah am Kunden-remote und vor Ort-und verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den Weg von der Anforderung bis zum produktiven Betrieb
  • Du förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit operativen und technischen Kundenvertretern, um Produktakzeptanz und Systemintegration zu verbessern
  • Du fungierst intern als Sprachrohr des Kunden-im engen Austausch mit Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und Support
  • Du übersetzt klinische Prozesse und fachliche Anforderungen in technische Schnittstellen- und Integrationskonzepte (u.a. HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR,openEHR, DICOM)
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Solution Architects und Technical Consultants im Team zusammen und unterstützt mit belastbaren technischen Konzepten (PoCs, Referenzlösungen)
  • Du übernimmst je nach Projektphase auch angrenzende Rollen im Team – etwa in der technischen Beratung, im Anforderungsmanagement oder in der Presales-Unterstützung
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Stakeholdern Projektumfang, Ziele, Anforderungen und die zu erbringenden Leistungen
  • Du verantwortest Projektbudgets, Zeitpläne und Ressourcen sowie das Projektcontrolling und die Berichterstattung
  • Du steuerst Datenintegrationsprojekte und stellst eine reibungslose Verbindung zwischen den beteiligten Systemen sicher
  • Du identifizierst Projektrisiken, entwickelst geeignete Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung und stellst den Projekterfolg sicher
  • Du koordinierst die Kommunikation zwischen technischen und nicht-technischen Beteiligten und informierst alle Stakeholder über den Projektfortschritt 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Gesundheitswesen mit, idealerweise im Krankenhausumfeld, davon einen wesentlichen Anteil in einer technischen Projektmanagement-, Solution-Delivery- oder vergleichbar technisch geprägten Funktion
  • Du verfügst mindestens über einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Medizininformatik, eHealth oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von Gesundheitstechnologien sowie in der Steuerung komplexer Schnittstellen- und Datenintegrationsprojekte im klinischen Umfeld
  • Du besitzt praktische Erfahrung mit klinischen Prozessen, IT-Architekturen und Systemen wie HIS, RIS, PACS und ERP sowie mit Standards wie HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR, DICOM und idealerweise openEHR
  • Du hast idealerweise Vorerfahrung als Solution Consultant oder im technischen Presales, kannst Anforderungen technisch lesen und kommunizierst mit Architekt:innen und Entwickler:innen auf Augenhöhe
  • Du bringst die Flexibilität mit, in wechselnden Rollen und Projektkontexten zu arbeiten, und stellst Dich schnell auf neue Kunden, Themen und Technologien ein
  • Du bist bereit, für Kundeneinsätze projektabhängig zu reisen – überwiegend im deutschsprachigen Raum
  • Du arbeitest routiniert cross-funktional mit anderen Fachbereichen
  • Du kommunizierst präzise, freundlich und serviceorientiert und überzeugst durch eine hohe Kundenorientierung
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, lösungs- und geschäftsorientiert und verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Selbstorganisation
  • Du bist in der Lage, mehrere Projekte parallel zu steuern und nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

title: Werkstudent EV Sales & Deal Operations (m/w/d)
description: Über Aampere Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt. Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG. Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams. Deine Mission Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform. Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft. Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten. Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen. Das bringst du mit Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse. Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl. Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten. Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr. Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift. Why Aampere? Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle. Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats) Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next? Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. Chance auf Übernahme : Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte. Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn... ...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. ...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten. ...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren. ...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt. ...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen. Wie wir arbeiten Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen: Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun. Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen. Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion. Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam. Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht. raw.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.

description: Deine Aufgaben Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst. Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung. Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt. Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert. In den ersten sechs Monaten Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen Danach Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun Dein Profil Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung Du kannst ein Datenmodell beurteilen und eine Architekturdiskussion moderieren, ohne sie an dich zu reißen Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence. We are looking for people who want to build. People who are scrappy, entrepreneurial, hands-on, and hungry to make an impact. title: Head of Brand & Marketing (m/w/d)
description: Wir wollen die lautesten Handpulled Noodles Europas werden. Dafür fehlt uns die Person, die das kreativ führt. Bang Bang Noodles macht Handpulled Noodles. Jede Nudel von Hand gezogen, mitten im Restaurant, so dass du es siehst, hörst und spürst. Heute zwei Stores in Berlin, Kreuzberg und Mitte. Morgen deutlich mehr: Wir bauen gerade das Franchise System auf und wollen im nächsten Jahr fünf weitere Standorte eröffnen, auch außerhalb Berlins. Dazu ein starkes Team und ein Markengesicht, das schon heute Reichweite hat. Not authentic. Just really good. Wir erzählen keine Traditionsgeschichten. Wir zeigen, was wir können, und wir sind dabei laut. Mit Absicht. Was uns fehlt, ist die Person, die diese Haltung jeden Tag in Content, Kampagnen und Markenauftritt übersetzt. Nicht als Verwalter, sondern als Motor. Aufgaben Du führst die Marke. Tonalität, Look, Guidelines, und du hast das letzte Wort bei allem, was BBN nach außen zeigt: Content, Karte, Stores, Merch, Kooperationen. Du baust unser Content System. Formate für TikTok, Reels und Stories, ein Redaktionsplan, feste Drehroutinen mit unserer Gründerin als Gesicht und der Küche als Bühne. Du produzierst selbst. Handy raus, drei Clips in der Küche, schneiden, posten. Du bist dabei nicht allein: Im Team gibt es Leute, die filmen und schneiden können und dich an festen Tagen unterstützen, und für größere Drehs holst du Freelancer und führst sie. Du entwickelst Brand Momente, die Berlin mitbekommt, von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, und steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn es welche braucht. Du lieferst Creatives für Paid Social und holst dir die Learnings zurück in die Planung. Paid selbst liegt aktuell beim Founder und kann perspektivisch zu dir wandern. Du bringst die Marke in jeden Kiez. Lokales Marketing für die bestehenden Stores und vor allem für Neueröffnungen: Launch Kampagnen, Nachbarschaft, Creator, Events. Beim Opening bist du vor Ort, auch wenn es in einer anderen Stadt ist. Du machst die Marke auch nach innen sichtbar: Employer Brand für unser Recruiting und Material und Playbooks für unsere Franchise Partner, damit jeder Standort so laut ist wie der erste. Du hast ein eigenes Produktionsbudget und entscheidest, wofür es draufgeht. Qualifikation Mindestens fünf Jahre in Brand, Content oder Kreation, angestellt oder in der Agentur. Und du hast an mindestens einer Marke mitgearbeitet, die man erkennt, weil sie Charakter hat. Consumer, Food, Lifestyle, egal welche Branche. Du kannst es selbst. Kurze Videos mit dem Handy drehen und schneiden, Texte schreiben, Plattformen bedienen. Kein Profi Cutter nötig, aber auch kein reiner Stratege. Du verstehst TikTok und Instagram aus der Praxis, nicht aus Reports. Geschmack und Haltung. Du sagst nein, wenn etwas nicht zur Marke passt, auch zu uns. Deutsch und Englisch sicher. Du bist in Berlin und willst in den Stores sein, nicht nur im Büro. Reisebereitschaft. Bei Openings in anderen Städten bist du für ein paar Tage dabei, das gehört zum Job. Benefits 60.000 bis 80.000 € brutto, je nach Erfahrung. Direkte Freigabe ohne Schleifen. Du sprichst mit den Gründern, nicht mit einem Komitee. Eigenes Office in Berlin für Konzept und Schnitt, die Stores als Set direkt vor der Tür. Eigenes Produktionsbudget und Freelancer, die du selbst auswählst. Eine Marke mit fertigem Fundament und ohne fertige Antworten. Vision, Werte und Tonalität stehen, alles andere baust du. Eine Firma, die gerade den Sprung ins Franchise macht. Was du jetzt aufbaust, wird die Vorlage für jeden weiteren Standort. Und die Rolle wächst mit: Wer heute die Marke für zwei Stores führt, führt in zwei Jahren ein Team. Weiterbildung ist uns wichtig. Eigenes Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen und Coaching, du entscheidest, was dich weiterbringt. Noodles. So viele du willst. So läuft es ab: Du bewirbst dich mit Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben und beantwortest eine Frage: Was würdest du bei uns als Erstes lauter machen? Kein Anschreiben. Dann ein erstes Gespräch mit den Gründern, 30 Minuten, Haltung und Fit. Danach ein bezahlter Case: dein 90 Tage Plan für BBN, präsentiert im Store. Zum Schluss ein zweites Gespräch zu Rahmen und Vertrag. Vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Entscheidung: maximal vier Wochen. Made loud. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und übernimmst Ownership für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Operations-Hubs in Kairo – von der strategischen Konzeption bis in die operative Umsetzung (z. B. PMO für unsere Aufbau-Initiativen, Design des Operating Models für neue Funktionen, Prozessoptimierung gemeinsam mit den Teams vor Ort). Dabei baust du die Brücke zwischen unseren Teams in Deutschland und Ägypten – mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung, steiler Lernkurve und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum vom ersten Tag an. Ramp-up Planung Du entwickelst detaillierte Pläne für den Aufbau neuer Teams und Funktionen in Kairo – inklusive Wissensaufbau und Ressourcenplanung. Operating Model & Prozessdesign Du gestaltest das Operating Model für die neuen Funktionen, prüfst Workflows auf Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit und optimierst die Prozesse gemeinsam mit dem Team. PMO & Program Governance Du baust das PMO-Framework für unsere Aufbau-Initiativen auf, steuerst Timelines und schaffst Transparenz für die Führung an beiden Standorten. Financial Tracking Du verfolgst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung gegen den Business Case und machst die Ergebnisse für die Geschäftsführung transparent. Continuous Improvement Cross-functional Collaboration Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen allen internen Bereichen in Deutschland und in Kairo und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven pragmatisch zusammen. Dein Profil Relevante Erfahrung 2–4 Jahre in Top-Tier Consulting oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Aufbau internationaler Standorte (z. B. in einem GCC, BPO oder Shared-Service-Center). Strukturierte Problemlösung Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Situationen und übersetzt unklare Ausgangslagen in pragmatische Lösungen – auf dem Papier und im Alltag. Business Case & Financial Acumen Du fühlst Dich sicher in Business Cases, Cost-Benefit-Analysen und KPI-Tracking und begründest wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen fundiert. Eigenverantwortung & Umsetzungsstärke Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Workstreams und bringst Themen mit hoher Eigenständigkeit ins Ziel – hands-on, pragmatisch, ergebnisorientiert. Interkulturelle Kommunikationsstärke Klar und adressatengerecht – vom Werkstudiernden bis zum Management, über Standort- und Kulturgrenzen hinweg. Deutsch und Englisch auf C1+ Niveau. Reisebereitschaft Ca. eine Woche pro Monat vor Ort in Kairo, die restliche Zeit aus unserem Office in Berlin. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe. We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch. As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands. Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! YOUR TASKS End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions. Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed. Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production. Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start. Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving. Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows. title: Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
description: About us NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions. NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia. Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights. We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI. Responsibilities Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data. Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Tasks

Your core mandate sits on four priorities.

1. Topic ownership and expertise

  • Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics.
  • Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success.
  • Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons.

2. Benchmark reports and original research

  • Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring.
  • Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people.

3. Content production

  • Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections.
  • Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics.
  • Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials.

4. Publishing and maintenance

  • Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals.

Required

title: Senior / Principal Game Engineer
description: Please note that this is a hybrid position based in Brighton, requiring 3 days onsite each week, with the option for remote work on the remaining days. Part of the Rocket Science Group, Atomic Theory comprises a multinational team of seasoned AAA veterans with roots extending from Blizzard, PUBG, Epic, and Unity. We have a track record of delivering player-centric, AAA-quality experiences, and we're unwavering in our commitment to performance, accessibility, and the meticulous attention to the engineering tools and frameworks that underpin exceptional gameplay. But Atomic Theory is also more than just a studio; for us, it's a sanctuary, a place where our diverse experiences can intersect and combine to carry our solutions to the next level. We're dedicated to aiding studios and publishers in navigating the toughest challenges across today's game development landscape -- and with offices in Albany NY, Brighton UK and Cardiff UK, we thrive at the opportunity to Get Sh!t Done on a global scale. Our passion for gaming is at the core of everything we do, inspiring us to collaborate seamlessly. We're not afraid to take on big challenges and push for bold, innovative solutions. Every decision we make is guided by the goal of delivering maximum value and creating a significant, positive impact on our projects. By consistently going above and beyond, we transform every interaction into an exceptional partnership, building trust and delivering excellence. ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a Principal Game Engineer to join our growing co-dev team. In this role, you will take ownership of the systems players feel most directly: gameplay, UI, 3Cs (character, camera, and controls), and AI. Working across a variety of partner projects, you will design, implement, and refine the systems that drive the moment-to-moment experience, bringing expert engineering judgement to everything from input handling and camera behaviour to UI architecture and core gameplay systems. As a principal engineer, you will set the technical direction in your area, act as a trusted, customer-facing point of contact for our partners, and raise the bar for quality across the wider team. An ideal candidate is passionate about games, has deep experience building player-facing systems in Unreal Engine (or similar), combines expert C++ and C# skills with strong 3D maths, and has a track record of delivering polished, responsive player systems and experiences. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Player Experience Development: Design, implement, and polish gameplay features, UI systems, and 3Cs (character, camera, and controls) that feel responsive, intuitive, and satisfying in players' hands. Technical Leadership: Own the technical direction for player experience work across projects, making sound architectural decisions, anticipating risks, and guiding solutions from prototype through to ship quality. Customer-Facing Collaboration: Act as a senior technical representative to our partners, gathering requirements, presenting solutions, communicating trade-offs clearly, and building the trust that underpins great co-development relationships. Critical Problem Solving: Apply strong analytical and debugging skills, including profiling and diagnostic tools, to investigate and resolve complex technical issues across gameplay, UI, and engine-level systems. Mentorship: Support and mentor engineers across the team, sharing expertise in player experience engineering and helping to grow the studio's capabilities in gameplay, UI, and 3Cs. Code Review: Champion high standards of code quality, performance, and maintainability through code reviews, constructive feedback, and by setting the example in your own work. WHAT WE VALUE: Expert Software Engineering: Extensive professional experience developing and shipping games, with the depth of judgement expected at a principal level and a history of delivering high-quality, player-facing systems. Strong C++ and C# Skills: Expert proficiency in C++ and C#, with a commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Strong 3D Maths: A firm grasp of the linear algebra and geometry that underpin cameras, character movement, animation, and gameplay systems. Unreal Engine Skills: Deep experience developing player-facing systems in Unreal Engine, including the Gameplay Framework, UMG/Slate, and input and camera systems. Unreal experience is preferred, though we also value strong Unity backgrounds. Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills and a proactive, methodical approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving technical challenges. Customer-Facing Communication: Confidence and clarity when working directly with partners and stakeholders, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to varied audiences. Player Focus: An instinct for what makes games feel great, and the craft to translate that instinct into responsive controls, readable UI, and satisfying gameplay. Team Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with engineers, designers, artists, producers, and project leads. Passion for Gaming: A genuine enthusiasm for games and a desire to help create engaging, high-quality experiences for players. WHAT YOU MAY ALSO HAVE: Console Experience: Experience shipping titles on current-generation consoles such as PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, or Switch 2. Unity Experience: Professional experience developing and shipping games in Unity alongside your Unreal background. Advanced Unreal Experience: Familiarity with custom engine modifications, plugin development, the Gameplay Ability System, or working from Unreal Engine source. Accessibility Knowledge: Experience designing and implementing accessible controls, UI, and player options. Co-Development Experience: Prior experience in a co-dev, outsourcing, or external development environment working with multiple partners and codebases. WHAT WE CAN OFFER: Competitive Salary and Benefits Package: Your health and wellbeing is important to us, so we offer a variety of benefits including: Hybrid Working Arrangement: Our office in Brighton is located centrally. As a member of our team, you’ll have the flexibility to work at home and collaborate with your fellow team members in person. Private Pension via Salary Sacrifice Optional Private Medical , Dental , and Vision coverage Annual Leave , plus Bank Holidays and Winter Break Office Closure Annual Research Credit: We always encourage personal growth, so we provide all of our team members with an annual credit to further enhance your skills! Professional Development: We offer annual reviews, as well as opportunities to collaborate across disciplines, internal tech talks, and the chance to learn from specialists with backgrounds from across the games and software development industries. Work-Life Balance: We really believe that home life comes first and we promote a flexible working environment. And as an added bonus: We don’t crunch! Family Friendly: We understand the importance of family, which is why we offer 6 weeks full of Maternity, Paternity, and Adoption Leave to support you during this exciting time! Office Perks: In addition to everything above, we also provide: Weekly Team Lunches Snacks, Including the Good (Yorkshire) Tea Fully Equipped Team Lounge, Including our Favourite Consoles and Games And, most importantly, a supportive and creative working environment made up of talented and friendly people, as well as the opportunity to work on some pretty cool games and projects – if we do say so ourselves! A FRIENDLY NOTE FROM THE RECRUITMENT TEAM: Let us do the work for you: Even if your profile isn’t an exact match for all of the qualifications listed above, we still want you to apply. Our team members come from a variety of different industries, not all of which are immediately relevant to game or software development, and we welcome all candidates of similarly varied backgrounds, communities, and identities. Rocket Science is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a worry-free workplace void of discrimination or harassment. Rocket Scientists are expected to foster and champion an environment in which everyone has the opportunity to feel included and is afforded the respect and dignity they deserve. Rocket Science does not accept unsolicited résumés from recruiters, employment agencies, or staffing firms. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Marketplace Optimisation Lead
description: As our next Marketplace Optimisation Lead , you'll play a key role in helping us build the UK's go-to home improvement marketplace. Analytics tooling — including AI — is doing more of the heavy lifting on execution, and this role is the human layer above it: making sure the numbers are right. This role is perfect for someone with data science experience who enjoys working with data scientists on building models and systems with huge impact but also wants to own the strategy and direction of their work and work closely with the C-suite on driving the company forward with more intelligent, data-driven systems Forget long lists, here's what you'll actually spend your time on: Owning metric integrity — defining and governing what our numbers actually mean, so no one downstream is making a call off a flawed definition or a dodgy query. Acting as the quality gate on AI-generated analysis — checking the logic, validating the output, and catching errors before they ever reach a stakeholder. Designing and interpreting A/B tests — setting the success metrics, sizing the sample properly, and knowing when a result is underpowered rather than just running with it. Diagnosing what's actually driving commercial performance — why revenue is moving, where leads are dropping out of the funnel, which segments are underperforming — and turning that into a structured investigation with real hypotheses. Turning analysis into action — sizing the commercial impact, laying out the trade-offs, and helping the business decide what to do differently, then tracking whether it worked. Building interactive dashboards and self-serve tools that keep stakeholders oriented day-to-day, without an analyst needing to be in the loop every time. It's not about ticking every box. It's about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You'll do well here if you bring: A track record across all three layers — not just producing analysis, but diagnosing the cause and driving the action that actually changed the outcome. The analytical foundation to sense-check AI-generated work — fluency with SQL, Python and data concepts, so you know when an output is wrong before anyone else spots it. Experience designing experiments and turning statistical findings into commercial recommendations that hold up under scrutiny. A knack for explaining complex findings to non-technical audiences in a way that actually moves a decision — experience in a marketplace, subscription or lead-generation business, or with tools like Tableau or Looker, is a bonus rather than a must. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our team to meet that demand. The Opportunity We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the core services that underpin Aveni’s platform. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with responsibility for the architecture, quality and operational reliability of the foundations our product teams build upon. You’ll work across areas including client-data ingestion and preprocessing, CRM integrations and APIs, multi-tenancy, identity and authentication, and data lifecycle and retention. You’ll lead the technical direction of a team of around six to seven engineers, remaining close to the code while making architectural decisions, setting engineering standards and helping other engineers grow. Our platform supports regulated financial-services organisations, so reliability, security, auditability and data isolation aren’t afterthoughts — they’re fundamental to how we design and build. What You’ll Be Doing Owning the technical architecture and direction of Aveni’s core platform services. Designing and building scalable, event-driven services on AWS. Developing and evolving our client-data ingestion capabilities, enabling new clients and data sources to be onboarded increasingly through configuration rather than bespoke engineering. Building and maintaining APIs that give Aveni products a consistent way to consume client and CRM data. Designing robust multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, security and operational controls. Leading our approach to data lifecycle management, including retention, deletion, residency and GDPR requirements. Building resilient integrations with third-party platforms and APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, retries, reconciliation and failure recovery. Making and documenting architectural decisions and representing Core Services in Architecture Review Board discussions. Raising engineering standards across testing, observability, security, reliability and operational ownership. Remaining hands-on with production code, primarily across Node.js and AWS. Mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions and technical coaching. Helping the team make effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle while maintaining strong engineering judgement and appropriate controls. What We’re Looking For Essential Significant software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and architectural decision-making. Deep production experience with Node.js, particularly across backend, API and distributed systems. Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native systems on AWS. Experience building event-driven architectures and an understanding of the challenges that come with asynchronous distributed systems. Experience designing production systems with complex multi-tenancy, data isolation or data lifecycle requirements. Strong experience integrating with third-party APIs and designing for rate limits, partial failures, retries and reconciliation. A strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational ownership. Experience making architectural trade-offs and communicating technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders. A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards. The ability and desire to remain hands-on while providing technical direction to a team. Desirable Production experience with Python alongside Node.js. Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Auth0, AWS Cognito or similar. Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0 and authentication/authorisation patterns. Experience building software within financial services or another regulated environment. Experience handling data residency, retention and GDPR erasure requirements at scale. Experience contributing to Architecture Review Boards or similar technical governance forums. Experience establishing or improving AI-assisted software engineering practices. The Kind of Technical Lead We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who has moved completely away from engineering. You’ll still design systems, review code, solve difficult technical problems and contribute to production software. At the same time, you’ll create leverage by helping the engineers around you make better decisions and take greater ownership. You’ll be comfortable asking questions before reaching for a solution, thinking through failure modes as carefully as the happy path, and balancing architectural quality with the realities of delivering software in a fast-growing business. raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

The Compliance function is Allica Bank's independent second line for managing regulatory compliance risk. It helps the Bank grow safely by making regulatory obligations clear, practical and evidenced, while preserving 1LOD ownership of day-to-day compliance and maintaining independent oversight and challenge.

This role sits within the compliance and conduct team, reporting to the “Senior Manager Compliance and Conduct”. The wider department includes Financial Crime, Operational Risk, and an Assurance team, all of which report to the Chief Compliance Officer (SMF16). The compliance and conduct team support the design and operation of a scalable compliance risk framework for a UK business bank serving SME customers.

Role Description

  • Provide independent 2LOD oversight, advice and challenge over the Bank's compliance with applicable FCA, PSR, FSCS and other relevant regulatory obligations, which can include PRA requirements in conjunction with the 2LOD Financial Risk teams.

  • Maintain and develop the regulatory compliance framework, obligations inventory, regulatory change process, perimeter and permissions oversight, regulatory reporting oversight, breach and notification framework, SMCR governance support, regulatory engagement processes and compliance MI.

  • The role supports, advises, monitors, challenges and escalates to the CCO/SMF16 and relevant governance forums.

  • In scope: regulatory compliance framework, obligations mapping, rule interpretation, regulatory change, compliance advice and challenge, regulatory reporting oversight, breach/notification management, SMCR governance support, policy standards, evidence management and senior governance reporting.

  • Out of scope: Conduct Risk ownership, Consumer Duty/customer outcome monitoring, fair value, vulnerable customer oversight, complaints root cause, DISP ownership, customer redress, Financial Crime, prudential risk ownership, operational resilience ownership, formal legal advice, Internal Audit and 1LOD control operation.

Principal Accountabilities

The role holder will own and be responsible for a number of the following accountabilities, and will support the “Senior Manager Compliance and Conduct" with the others.

The split of tasks will be determined by the experience of the role holder (i.e. you do not need to have experience for all the below, but you must be able to take responsibility for a number of these accountabilities). The ultimate Accountability remains with the SMF16.

  • Maintain and develop the Bank's regulatory compliance framework, including taxonomy, risk appetite, KRIs, policy standards, obligations mapping, Horizon Scanning, escalation routes and governance reporting.

  • Maintain the regulatory obligations inventory and map applicable requirements to accountable owners, policies, controls, MI, assurance and evidence.

  • Provide 2LOD advice and challenge on FCA/PRA Handbook requirements, permissions, perimeter, regulatory change, SMCR, regulatory reporting, breaches, notifications and regulatory engagement.

  • Support 1LOD on perimeter and permissions assessments for new products, business changes, partnerships, customer segments, distribution models, countries of operation and structural changes.

  • Own or support regulatory change and horizon scanning, including impact assessment, gap analysis, implementation oversight and reporting to governance forums.

  • Review and challenge new product papers, including product compliance checklists, financial promotions, product information, and any rule applicability.

  • Oversee the regulatory reporting governance requirements, including defined ownership, processes, controls, data lineage, sign-off, timeliness and breach escalation. Regulatory reporting returns are owned by relevant teams – this is an oversight responsibility in 2LOD.

  • Oversee regulatory breach management, including materiality assessment, root-cause challenge, remediation tracking, notification consideration and closure evidence.

  • Support with regulatory engagement and commitments, including supervisory correspondence, information requests, regulatory meetings, Dear CEO/portfolio letters (as part of Horizon Scanning), and the reporting for senior management updates.

  • Maintain compliance policies, standards, practical 1LOD guidance and regulatory training, including targeted guidance on financial promotions/social media, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Support HR on SMCR, FIT and accountability governance

  • Provide 2LOD oversight of FSCS/depositor protection obligations, including disclosure, eligibility, Single Customer View, exclusions view and testing evidence.

  • Produce clear, actionable compliance MI for senior management, ExCo, Board committees and relevant governance forums.

  • Maintain oversight of any other regulatory compliance requirements as required

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Strong UK banking regulatory compliance experience, ideally in a dual-regulated bank, building society, SME lender, payment services environment or comparable regulated financial services business.

  • Detailed working knowledge of FCA and PRA expectations relevant to a UK business bank, including SYSC, SUP, PRIN, BCOBS, FIT, PERG, SMCR, regulatory reporting, payments regulation and FSCS/depositor protection. PROD/ESG knowledge is desirable where applicable to the Bank's product set.

  • Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical controls, evidence standards, committee papers and business guidance.

  • Data-led and evidence-led: comfortable using MI, KRIs, breach data, monitoring outputs and audit findings to identify trends and drive remediation.

  • Must be comfortable using analytics and using and building AI-enabled tools safely and pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, governance, explainability, validation and human judgement.

  • Experience building or maintaining an obligations inventory, regulatory change process, compliance monitoring plan, breach/notification process and senior governance MI.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce CCO and committee-level reports that are concise, risk-based and root-cause analysis that support decisions.

  • Able to challenge senior stakeholders clearly while preserving the distinction between 2LOD oversight and 1LOD ownership.

  • Strong judgement on when to escalate, and when to seek specialist input from other departments.

  • Practical, disciplined and comfortable operating in a scaling bank where the control environment needs to mature without becoming unnecessarily bureaucratic

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

raw.title: GTM Associate
raw.description:
About Magentic

We're building next-generation AI agents that can manage entire procurement workflows, tackling one of the world's largest industries. Our mission is to make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient by combining cutting-edge AI with deep enterprise expertise.

Backed by Sequoia Capital, our team brings together experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We're still early, which means every person who joins has the opportunity to shape the company, influence the product, and have an outsized impact.

 

The Role

We're looking for a highly organised, ambitious GTM Associate to join our commercial team.

This is an ideal role for someone with 1-2 years of sales or go-to-market experience who wants to learn quickly in a fast-moving startup. You'll work closely with CEO and commercial team, supporting customer conversations from first meeting through to deal progression. You build the commercial, communication and customer-facing skills needed to succeed in enterprise go-to-market.

 

You'll meet with prospective customers (we focus on the Fortune 500), help prepare demos on our product, coordinate follow ups, keep opportunities moving, and gradually take on more customer ownership.

 

If you're curious, commercially minded and excited by AI, you'll be given significant responsibility from day one.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Join customer meetings to understand customer challenges and how Magentic solves them.

  • Help prepare and deliver product demonstrations alongside the commercial team.

  • Draft customer follow ups, proposals and responses to customer questions.

  • Research target accounts and support customer discovery to help progress commercial opportunities.

  • Work closely with product and engineering to share customer feedback and shape future product development.

  • Take on increasing ownership of customer conversations and commercial opportunities as you grow.

 

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone with 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing or commercial role who's excited to build a career in enterprise sales.

 

You don't need to have done this exact job before, but you should be eager to learn, comfortable taking ownership, and excited by the opportunity to work in a fast-moving AI startup.

You'll likely have:

 

  • 1–2 years of experience in a commercial, sales, customer success or other customer-facing role.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders and customers.

  • Curious, proactive and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • An AI-first mindset, using tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • A genuine interest in technology, startups and solving customer problems.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS.

  • Experience preparing presentations or customer-facing materials.

  • Exposure to procurement, supply chain or enterprise software.

 

Compensation And Benefits

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside

  • A salary of £55,000 - £65,000 per annum

  • In-office lunches provided

  • Monthly organised socials and an additional flexible monthly social budget for team lunches, coffees, dinners, or activities with colleagues

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Hybrid London HQ (3-4 days in the office/customer site)

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build

 

Our Interview Process

There are a few components because it's really important that both we and you have all the information to make a great decision at this stage of our journey. We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  1. Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

  2. Skills interview (60 mins with some prep): in this step, we'll ask you to present some of your work to us and discuss it.

  3. In-person interview: for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person and work alongside us! We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, a role-specific task and a discussion of your work with the team.

At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

 

Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

 

We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone.

raw.description:
At Plumerai, we make it easy and affordable for developers to add highly accurate AI to their camera devices, enabling them to create amazing new products. Major brands deploy our advanced computer vision models on millions of smart home cameras in the field and we're rapidly expanding into other sectors, such as commercial security, elderly care and retail. We combine our on-device Tiny AI software with our cloud-based Vision Language Models, to provide our customers with powerful AI features, including People Detection, Video Search, Familiar Face Identification, AI Captions and more. We prioritize on-device inference, to enable low-power, super-efficient and private AI products. Plumerai leads on accuracy, even when compared to large players, such as Google Nest.

 

We're a small, high-performing team based in London and Amsterdam, with plans to double in size over the next year. Following our recent $8.7M Series A, backed by world-class investors including Tony Fadell, Hermann Hauser, and Zoubin Ghahramani, we have multiple years of runway and rapidly growing recurring revenue.

 

We’re in a period of significant growth and are expanding our engineering team across multiple levels and specialisms. This is one of several hires we’re making as we scale the company.

 

🎥 Get to know Plumerai

Meet the team and see what it's like to work here:

▶️ Life at Plumerai

▶️ What we're building

Learn more here: Plumerai

👉 Read more: TechCrunch, Series A funding announcement

 

Role description

We are looking for a Senior Deep Learning Research Engineer that can help us develop state of the art AI products. This can involve anything from improving our training algorithms, training and integrating multimodal LLMs, building our data pipeline, designing new model architectures to using tried and tested ML approaches and coming up with clever algorithms. You will help us build new AI features that will be shipped to millions of camera devices in the field. Together we are building the most advanced AI for embedded devices.

What you will be doing

  • We combine our Tiny AI with multimodal LLMs to enable our advanced AI features for our customers. You will use and improve multimodal LLMs to achieve new functionality for our customers and optimize their deployments (cloud and edge).

  • Some of our deep learning models are truly tiny - the memory footprint of our smallest computer vision model is just 1MB. You will train and design more accurate models, while also enabling new and more complex AI applications on low-cost and low-power hardware.

  • You will improve our data pipeline, model architectures and training software. Sometimes there is relevant literature available, but novel approaches and clever hacks are often required for the problems that we are working on.

  • You will use our Kubernetes cluster to deploy PyTorch and TensorFlow training jobs, Snowflake and Dataflow to build datasets, tools like Streamlit to prototype new demos (try one of our live demos here) and lots of GPUs on GCP for training new models and auto-labeling data.

What You Need

  • +5 years of professional software engineering experience with proficiency in Python.

  • Comfortable with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, or JAX.

  • Strong experience with computer vision and multimodal LLMs.

  • Trained neural networks that moved into production.

Nice To Have

  • Industry experience with efficient inference deployments (cloud or edge).

  • Experience with Deep Reinforcement Learning.

We only consider applicants who are currently based in, or willing to relocate to, London or Amsterdam. We have flexible working hours and work together from our offices on at least 2 fixed days per week.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary.

  • Generous equity stake in the company.

  • Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship is provided.

  • Choose your own laptop and equipment.

  • 25 days of paid vacation time in addition to bank holidays.

  • Ability to attend top research conferences like NeurIPS, ICML and CVPR.

Process

Talent Screen

Technical Round I

Technical Round II

Cross Team & Executive Interview

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . Overview We're looking for someone hungry to learn to join us as our Office Manager ! You'll get an inside look at how a high-performing tech startup operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth startup moving and who have a passion for making things run smoothly around them. Your day-to-day will involve hands-on support across logistics, workflows (onboarding, offboarding, IT), office administration and socials, events and internal operations. Beyond this, you'll have the opportunity to assist with projects wherever an extra set of capable hands is needed, including exposure to finance and other internal teams. Along the way, you’ll gain practical insight into startup life and how different functions collaborate with one another. This is a rare opportunity to learn first-hand from a uniquely high-performing team as we scale a category-defining tech startup at speed. What You Can Expect Operational Cadence : You’ll help handle the admin, workflows and logistics that free up our leaders to focus and enable the entire business to move faster. You'll be part of running our onboarding, offboarding, contracting, scheduling, and administrative workflows - so being good with technology is a big plus! Beating heart of keeping the office culture running: you will help maintain our office environment (weekly food orders, office moves and fit-outs, managing our service providers for cleaning and reconfiguration) and plan our regular London socials and events. Wide exposure : You'll assist with administrative projects across all of Operations, whether it's helping out with month-end bookkeeping or regular payment runs, or helping the sales team plan their quarterly kick-offs. Learn by doing : Get involved in a range of tasks - help with onboarding, audits, events, socials, merch and scheduling. Where we have our company monthly meetings, you will also get exposure to IT and AV to make our hybrid events a great experience. Momentum : You’ll get a front row seat to what it's like to scale a company just as we enter a phase of high growth, with the systems, challenges, and excitement that come with it. About you We’re looking for someone curious, proactive, and ready to roll up their sleeves. You might be a recent grad, early in your career or pivoting from a different field - what matters is your energy, problem-solving mindset, organisational skills, and desire to learn. You’re organised, resourceful, and detail oriented : you like systems, details, and getting things done well. you get a lot of satisfaction from knowing that all the I's are dotted and the T's are crossed. you take satisfaction from knowing that things are ordered and up-to-date You’re technical for a non-technical person : you you can figure out how to do stuff with new tech tools pretty easily You’re exceptional at time management: you can comfortably manage changing priorities and are able to switch gears with ease and aren't thrown off by people making regular requests at the last minute You’re humble : we're seldom the stars of the show in operations, and parts of the job are not as glamorous! You take satisfaction in a job well done without needing to feel you own the limelight You’re good with people : you’re just as comfortable chatting to a senior leader as you are with a new hire - you'll be one of the first people that a lot of our new joiners meet. You're excited about startups: not just as a job, but as an environment where you can learn quickly, contribute meaningfully, and build the kind of hands-on operational expertise that only comes from being at the centre of a fast-growing company.. You adapt quickly, handle ambiguity, and keep things moving forward. You're based in London or nearby : this is an in-office role in Victoria. At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. You will be the voice of the banker inside our product organization — the person who knows, from years of first-hand experience, how relationship managers and treasury officers actually serve their clients, where the revenue lives in a commercial banking book, and what an insight has to look like before a banker will act on it. This is a product subject matter expert role first and foremost: you will shape the data and insights modules that Codat's Banking Context Engine generates for banker users. You will use these expertise in front of prospects and customers, working alongside our GTM team in conversations with some of the largest commercial banks in North America and the UK. The Role This role sits at a unique intersection between Product, GTM and strategy covering the following broad intersection. Design actionable insights: Work hand in hand with Product Managers to deliver the substance of the insight modules our Banking Context Engine delivers — defining what signals matter across Treasury & Payments, FX, supply chain finance, working capital and lending, what a banker needs to see to act, and what "actionable" genuinely means in the context of a client conversation. You'll separate insights that generate fee revenue and deepen relationships from noise that erodes banker trust. Be the voice of the banker: Bring the daily reality of commercial bankers and treasury management officers into every product decision — coverage models, portfolio reviews, pre-call preparation, annual pricing conversations, cross-sell motions — so that what we build fits how banks actually work rather than how outsiders imagine they work. Consult into the product build: Actively collaborate with our product and engineering teams as they build the Banking Context Engine and its MCP integration with Microsoft Copilot, translating banking domain knowledge into concrete requirements, evaluation criteria, and quality bars for generated insights. Support GTM as the banking SME: Join sales conversations, demos, and executive meetings with prospect and customer banks as the credible domain expert in the room. Support discovery by speaking the language of bank product heads, treasury management leaders and commercial banking executives, and help our GTM team pressure-test messaging against how banks really buy. Sharpen how banks measure value: Help build the ROI narratives that connect Codat's insights to outcomes banks care about — fee revenue growth from the existing book, expanded coverage without added headcount, and client retention against fintech encroachment. Build institutional knowledge: Codify what you know — banker workflows, product economics, org structures, buying dynamics — into reusable assets that raise the banking fluency of the whole company. description: About the Role Location: London / London-adjacent, with regular time expected in our London and/or Gloucester offices Function: Marketing Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer About the Role Radiant is looking for a Director of Technical Product Marketing to turn our technical advantages into clear, credible, market-facing narratives.
